operation_id.where: receipts sidecar (opt-in, receipts=True): seq, memory_id, hash chained to prev; without it every record still has an id

timestamp_ms.where: receipt ts (float seconds, sub-millisecond); history valid_from and invalidated_at

operation_type.where: a policy label on the retired version (keyed_lww, keyed_reaffirm) and meta.revert_of on a revert; no single type field

motive.where: a correction carries meta.reason; a revert and a steward decision carry one only since 2.27.7

content_snapshot.where: every version keeps its full text; a retired value is never deleted

alternatives.where: a refused write records what stopped it (echo_blocked, superseded_by_policy) and a reopened record surfaces the prior it contests; a plain landed write records no alternatives

rollback_path.where: revert(key) restores the prior value as a new record; both stay in history and the receipt chain verifies after it

operator_identity.where: agent_id per version (history.agent, stored as meta.aid) and a bound source document; the record a revert creates carries one only since 2.27.7

landing_anchor.where: source.observed_sha256 on the record; witness(bind_sources=True) re-reads the file at verify time and reports stale_at_use; per record, opt-in: a write without a source binds nothing

writer_below_the_agent.where: the Claude Code hook writes from the harness and stamps it as the agent; receipt_signer= keeps the key out of the process; a chain with one unsigned entry fails verification on a fresh handle; but the handle signs whatever the handle writes, so write authority stays with the caller

fresh_handle_problems: 1 of 2 chain entries carry NO signature while 1 do. A chain signed in places is not signed: something without the key appended to it.
require_signed_problems: receipt 1: unsigned, but a signature was required
1 of 2 chain entries carry NO signature while 1 do. A chain signed in places is not signed: something without the key appended to it.

authorized_vs_recorded.where: with a revert authority configured, a restore without a capability returns authorization_required; with revert_pubkey the store verifies and cannot mint; but no authority is the default and a default store restores on request, and an ordinary landed write carries no authorization mark
